## **Ads pressure** {#theme-ads}

<!--ir-theme:ads-->
   **Ads pressure.**
      2 recent review(s) mention ads pressure.
      Review window: Sep 25, 2026 - Sep 25, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users are noticing ad pressure. This can signal monetization friction and an opening for a cleaner competitor.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _89rr_, Sep 25, 2026, 1/5: "The constant ads and the shift of basic features into the premium package ensures you won’t use the free version. So if you do t want to spend the $80 a year, use another app (Cronometer) they took away barcode scanning for logging and every 3 seconds there is a pop up. It increases my blood pressure whenever I open the app. Their strategy works though I’m spending the $80."
            2. _dbfisher93_, Sep 25, 2026, 2/5: "I’ve used this app every day for three years. Calorie counter is nice, but tons of functions are paywalled, there are many ads, and regular annoying pleas for money. I could live with many of these, but a 2026 update made just about everything worse. Very disappointing."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      5 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jul 23, 2026 - Sep 24, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Kaspar Lee_, Sep 24, 2026, 1/5: "Literally a million settings and no setting for this, always getting random notifications at random times to try and get me back on the app, zero setting to turn off. Also app is quite buggy and over complicated."
            2. _IXE_04_, Sep 24, 2026, 1/5: "The app used to be way better. The UI is confusing, jumbled, and overall just horrible compared to the old one not to mention it glitches and lags way more now. figure it out!"
            3. _RuachOo_, Sep 19, 2026, 1/5: "The app has become so bloated over the years its extremely slow, and the unnecessary praising and popups is super annoying. Less clicks = better experience. It also often just freezes for 10seconds before responding again when i open the app"
